mechanism_narrative: A rising GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is followed by negative S&P 500 returns more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: If UNRATE exceeds 6%, it signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 6% does not result in negative returns in most cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE indicate economic stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The pattern does not result in negative returns during stress periods.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO growth during supply expansion signals positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not lead to positive returns in expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: High CPIAUCSL leads to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: High inflation does not result in negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Declining HOUST indicates weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Housing starts below 1000 do not result in negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth without PAYEMS growth indicates inefficiency, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: The pattern does not result in negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 4% during tightening signals negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: High FEDFUNDS do not result in negative returns during tightening.
